title: Àtte bi ci suufu vague yi
intro: Benn yonent, bi liggéeyam diis, jël dogal bu ko yóbbu fu sori ci askanam, dugg ci natt gumu xamul woon. Tukki bi dafa am coppite yu yéeme, mu natt ngëmam ak muñam ci anam wu gëna xóot. Ndax mën nga xam lu xew ci xew-xew bu yéeme bii ci li ñu la jox?
clues: Dañu yónnee benn yonent ci askan wi, waaye mu gaaw dem, ndax dañu ko bañ.
Tukki bi yóbbu ko ci géej gi, mu dugg ci gaal gu yab lu bari ngir wër barab bumu mëna jaar.
Dafa am tàngoor wu metti, di tiital gaal gi, ñu jël dogal sànni benn nit ci géej gi ngir wàcce li ñu yóbbu, ñu jël loxo ngir dogal ko.
Benn mbindéef bu xóot la wann ko, mu nekkoon kéemtaanu Boroomam.
Ci biir biiru mbindéef mi woote Boroomam, di tuub di màggal Yàlla ci lëndëm gi.
Ginaaw bimu ñaanee lu bari, ñu sànni ko ci tefes gu amul ndox, mu ñàkk doole waaye mu ngi dundu, ginaaw ga mu dellusi gis ni askanam gëm nañu ko.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Tukki bi ci biir jën wu mag wi
trial.answer: Tukki bi ci biir jën wu mag wi

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Kóllóre gu bees ak nit ñi
Dellu ci askanam ñi gëmoon ci jamono jooju
Ndam ci kaw njiit luy jaay doole
outcome.answer: Dellu ci askanam ñi gëmoon ci jamono jooju

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
